full_name: Frederick Schauer | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Frederick Schauer, Frank Stanton Professor of the First Amendment at Harvard’s Kennedy School of Government, teaches and writes about the philosophy of law and constitutional law.
